name: Mattermost Christmas Magic
description: Snowflakes, Santa's sleigh with sound and clickable gifts, a snowman on the message box, a rotating 3D Christmas tree showing /christmas wishes, and a personal animation switch.

settings_schema.header:
🎁 **Need a license key? [Get your Christmas Magic license here →](https://buymeacoffee.com/rsahan/e/594048)** Each key works on one Mattermost server.

Christmas Magic respects each user's reduced-motion preference and personal header switch.

settings.help_text:
Don't have a key yet? **[Get a license →](https://buymeacoffee.com/rsahan/e/594048)**

Enter your license key (format: MMXMAS-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). The plugin will not start without a valid key. If it failed to start, save the key, then disable and re-enable the plugin in Plugin Management.
Santa drops 2 to 4 presents per flight; they land on the message box. Requires Santa.
A snowman walks along the top of the message box. It never blocks typing or clicks.
A rotating 3D Christmas tree sits at the bottom-right corner of the message box and shows Christmas wishes in a speech bubble.
Users type /christmas followed by their wish. It appears in the tree's bubble for everyone, then saved wishes keep taking turns. Requires the tree.
Every wish sent with /christmas (up to the latest 500). Remove anything inappropriate; it disappears from everyone's tree immediately.
Plays sleigh bells, a "Jingle Bells" chorus and Santa saying "Ho ho ho, Merry Christmas" (about 11 seconds) when Santa flies by. Each user can mute it with the speaker button in the header.
Maximum flakes at desktop size, from 0 to 150. Automatically reduced on smaller screens and less capable devices.
30 to 3600 seconds. The first flight also waits this randomized interval.
At least the minimum wait, up to 3600 seconds.
Users can click a falling gift to open one of the gift messages below. When off, gifts are decorative and let clicks pass through.

settings.help_text: One message per line: the headline, then | and an optional smaller line. A random one is shown when a gift is opened. Clear the box to restore the built-in messages.
Adds a small "just kidding 😄" in the corner of every gift message. Turn off if your messages are real.
Optional YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive in each user's local timezone. Leave blank for no start limit.
Optional YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive in each user's local timezone. Leave blank for no end limit. Invalid dates disable effects.
